title: Using AI Effectively
content: AI as Employee: Use Al for Boring, Repetitive Tasks. Delegate Decision Making to Humans. Use Al as a Second Brain by Collecting and Analyzing Information. Build a Cogni Layer to Store Conversations and Learning. Use Agent Orchestrators and Skills to Enhance Performance. Ensure Al Operates with Good Context.
raw_text:
How to use Al effectivly

- Think of Al as employee not as ceo. Don't let it

take decision. Give him task to finish - boring, repetitive task should be given to Al - (search about agent, agen orchestration)

learn to give better context

make a second brain using LLMs. Try to build a

cogni layer. Which will collect all that u consume. All the conversations u have with ai, youtube videos, and all this will run locally on a dedicated machine. You will need to know agent harness. Also learn how to make skills

- Al is like super smart employee u hired from MIT, IIT but it will need good context to perform well.
